title: Equipment details
purpose: Review one asset, current due dates, calibration and maintenance records and linked issues.

sections.title: Access and navigation
paragraphs: Available to active signed-in lab staff with an admin, custodian, analyst, reviewer, approver or project manager role. Client accounts and accounts without a lab role cannot open laboratory pages. Sidebar links open Lab overview, Inventory, Equipment, Training and Nonconformances. Breadcrumbs return to the list or parent record.

items.label: Asset ID, status, name, location and type
items.description: Identity and current placement/status; type appears when supplied.

items.label: Edit
items.description: Admin and reviewer roles can change descriptive details with a reason.

items.label: Change status
items.description: Admin and reviewer roles can switch In service, Out of service or Retired with a reason.

items.label: Record maintenance / Record calibration
items.description: Admin, analyst and reviewer roles can append events on non-retired assets. Allowed while Out of service. New events do not automatically change status. The primary (filled) button is the more urgent of the two: overdue before due soon, then the earlier due date; calibration when neither is more urgent.

items.label: Correct
items.description: For admin, analyst and reviewer roles on an uncorrected event of a non-retired asset. Adds a replacement with a reason; preserves original.

sections.title: Due dates and alerts
paragraphs: For each kind, dates and outcomes come from the latest uncorrected event by performed date, then record ID descending. No interval is calculated. A date is overdue only after it passes. The date is shown as text; an Overdue … d pill follows it once it has passed, and a Due today or Due in … d pill within the fixed 30-day highlight. Later dates carry no pill; blank reads Not scheduled. The filter window may differ from this fixed highlight.

Due dates show the latest performed date as Last. Out of service shows a warning. Overdue dates show an alert for non-retired equipment; retired detail still retains due-date facts. Missing dates mean no schedule was recorded, not that an interval is assumed. Not acceptable prompts consideration of a nonconformance; it does not create one or take the asset out of service.

items.label: Rows and order
items.description: Up to 200 events, performed date newest first then ID descending; earlier records are kept and no pagination is provided.

items.label: Performed
items.description: Date work was performed, distinct from system recording time.

items.label: Kind
items.description: Calibration or Maintenance. Corrected marks a superseded original; Correction marks a replacement.

items.label: Outcome
items.description: Calibration uses Acceptable or Not acceptable; maintenance uses Completed or Not acceptable.

items.label: By
items.description: Staff performer if supplied, otherwise outside provider. The recording actor is retained separately in audit history.

items.label: Reference
items.description: Optional certificate/work order/procedure text, with description and correction reason beneath it.

items.label: Next due
items.description: Entered lab-set date for that event, or dash.

items.label: Evidence
items.description: Attachment link with size and shortened checksum or No file.

items.label: No calibration or maintenance recorded
items.description: Record the first event and the next due date the lab decides.

sections.title: Linked nonconformances
paragraphs: Shows up to the newest 20 linked records, with Number link, Title and Status; count is displayed rows. Add nonconformance preselects this asset and Equipment category. An empty state appears when none are linked.

sections.title: Evidence files
paragraphs: Attach a nonempty PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT or CSV no larger than 10 MiB. TXT/CSV must be UTF-8; PDF and image bytes must match the extension. Evidence is optional unless a step requires a reference or file. Downloads are attachments, not inline previews. File links show name, size and the first 12 SHA-256 checksum characters. No file indicates no stored attachment. Staff can download equipment/nonconformance evidence; training evidence is limited to the person and lead roles. A correction is a new record: an earlier attachment is not copied automatically, so attach evidence again if it belongs on the new record.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: History shows up to the latest 50 audit events, oldest of those first and the newest last. Each shows action, recorded time, actor and reason when supplied. If the record has more than 50 audit events, older events beyond this cap are not shown in this panel. They remain stored. This panel is separate from the operational ledger or timeline.

sections.title: Record footer
paragraphs: The footer repeats the record identifier and shows Viewed with the time this page was produced in the deployment time zone and the signed-in viewer. This is a viewing timestamp, distinct from creation, event, review or closure time. Numbered section headings identify panels on the record page.
